Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files using AES-256 in CBC mode with a random key, RSA encrypted and stored in aes.bin; appends .chsch extension to encrypted files; drops ransom notes impersonating a movie character
Deployment via PowerShell script named POWERGAP used to distribute ransomware payloads from domain controllers
Attack Vector: PowerShell script used to distribute ransomware from domain controller
Indicators of Compromise: aes.bin file containing RSA encrypted key
Date of Discovery: Monday of the week the article was published (exact date not specified)
